metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: Birds are sent out to bring the desired delicacies to the palace. Wé Opu Sengngeng gives birth to twins, a boy (Sawérigading) and a girl (Wé Tenriabéng). Both undergo the same ceremonies as described in vol.1. Together with his wives, Batara Guru returns to heaven to stay there for good. His grandson Sawérigading, too, rises to heaven but returns to marry his niece Wé Panangngareng. Sawérigading meets the Creator in heaven.
